sections.text: Business class is a travel class on airlines that is more expensive than economy.

sections.heading: Fares and seats
sections.text: Fare class strongly shapes price: a business seat typically costs several times the economy price. Seats available per flight are far fewer in business class, and passengers per flight are fewer as well.
